video_title: NBA Opening Night: Tatum Under PRESSURE, LeBron's Philly Debut & Wemby vs. OKC

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's pressure to win MVP and be the best
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum on record saying that he wants to win the MVP. He considers himself the best.
quotes.quote: We heard Jayson Tatum on record saying that he wants to win the MVP. We heard him say he considers himself the best player in the league. The stage is set. Is he ready to dance?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Iverson's legacy without a championship
quotes.excerpt: Allen Iverson, his career without a championship might be up there with the best of the best.
quotes.quote: There's Magic and Bird, there's Jordan, there's Bron, there's Allen Iverson. His career without a championship might be up there with the best of the best of the best.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins' fashion choices and confidence
quotes.excerpt: The fact that you wore a white shirt with the beige, that's a lot of confidence right there.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: You can't relate. I understand, I get it.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You got so much beige in. The fact that you wore a white shirt with the beige, that's a lot of confidence right there. A lot of confidence on your part.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics' team dynamics without Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: Not necessarily the game, but just to see how they flow without Jayson Tatum.
quotes.quote: I think honestly the Boston Celtics. Not necessarily the game, but just to see how they flow without Jayson Tatum and see how Jayson Tatum goes and is the leader of that team. The lineups they throw out, like asking Derrick White to do more now. What is Peyton Pritchard going to do? What's his role going to be? Can he start the season off correctly and can he still score if he's not coming off the bench?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons' roster challenges and expectations
quotes.excerpt: It's a lot of what-ifs with the Detroit Pistons. You lose Tobias Harris and Isaiah Stewart.
quotes.quote: It's a lot of what-ifs with the Detroit Pistons. You lose Tobias Harris who was the second best player on their squad in the playoffs, and then you lose Isaiah Stewart who was the second best rim protector in the league last year behind Victor Wembanyama. It's a lot of question marks with the Detroit Pistons. Can they be the number one option? They were the number one seed.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's pressure as a top NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum is up there with Luka Doncic and Anthony Edwards for guys under the most pressure.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum is up there with Luka Doncic and Anthony Edwards for guys that are under the most pressure in the NBA. I know people say he's a champion, I get all that, but it's a lot that goes into this.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's role and impact on the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I look at what Paul George can give them, the health of Jayson Tatum and Paul George.
quotes.quote: I look at what Paul George can give them, the health of Jayson Tatum and Paul George. So I like that matchup just seeing how Boston is going to start the season.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Is Joel Embiid going to be the defensive monster like we've seen in the past?
quotes.quote: Honestly Joel Embiid's enthusiasm. Is he going to play with the slower kind of group or how healthy is his knee? Is he going to be the defensive monster like we've seen in the past? Does he have that bounce? Even a little bit of bounce will go a long way. When Joel Embiid's crazy aggressive, he's the best player on the team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' need for rhythm and health
quotes.excerpt: If they are healthy in game 83, that's all that matters.
quotes.quote: If they are healthy in game 83, that's all that matters. And then it's how much of a rhythm do they have. If guys are out in and out, they're coming back with eight games left, they're coming back with five games left. If they have 10-12 games with their roster going into the postseason and they're healthy, they're going to be very, very difficult.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's system and player buy-in
quotes.excerpt: I think that's Nick Nurse having them buy into his system.
quotes.quote: I think that's Nick Nurse having them buy into his system and saying, hey, trust me that I'm going to allow all you guys to get off and still keep your individual careers in the view, but the team's individual careers. Like, hey Joel Embiid, if you're not running back, I got to play somebody else and now we have options. Don't take that personally.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Importance of communication and sacrifice for championship teams
quotes.excerpt: I think the key starts with communication, but then after that it goes into are they willing to sacrifice.
quotes.quote: I think the key starts with communication, but then after that it goes into are they willing to sacrifice. Again, everybody has a role. Every championship team, I'll go back to the Knicks and OKC, the last two champions. Everybody did their role at an elite level.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' influence on the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: When LeBron James signed with Philadelphia, the first thing a week or two later that we saw circulating was that all of those guys were in the gym together.
quotes.quote: When LeBron James signed with Philadelphia, the first thing a week or two later that we saw circulating around social media was that all of those guys were in the gym together. That's a major thing. Like when guys get together, because it's one thing to work out together and be on the floor, but it's the conversations and it's the dinners, it's the things that happen outside the basketball court where you start to learn one another.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.excerpt: I think that they're going to play with great pace. LeBron James was topping in transition.
quotes.quote: I think that they're going to play with great pace. LeBron James was topping in transition, obviously Maxey and Jalen Brunson was topping the league in blowbys. Can Joel Embiid be caught with Anthony Towns was for the Knicks last year defensively? That's it. Are you going to be able to be better in the pick and roll?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and LeBron James' feelings of disrespect
quotes.excerpt: We know how Jalen Brunson feel right now. He feels like he's been disrespected his entire career.
quotes.quote: We know how Jalen Brunson feel right now. He feels like he's been disrespected his entire career. And LeBron James somewhat feels disrespected too.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: I thought Denver had a championship hangover. A lot of things that they were known for that they did well, a lot of that fell off.
quotes.quote: I thought Denver had a championship hangover. I thought when Denver won, the year after they won, a lot of things that they were known for that they did well, a lot of that fell off. Now that also has to do with health. I think the hangover is health. I think the hangover is your GM and your owner don't address the issues that you should.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: New York Knicks' transformation after the break
quotes.excerpt: After the break is when they became the Knicks, right? Because they bought in.
quotes.quote: After the break is when they became the Knicks, right? Because they bought in, right? When when we interviewed LeBron James and he was like, hey, everyone had to sacrifice because I think they had lost three, four, whatever, six of eight games or something like that. So then that's why in the playoffs, that team started to click because Mike Brown's system, they finally bought into that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: Allen Iverson's career is not like he's not a he's okay, there's Magic and Bird, there's Jordan, there's Bron, there's Allen Iverson.
quotes.quote: Allen Iverson's career is not like he's not a he's okay, there's Magic and Bird, there's Jordan, there's Bron, there's Allen Iverson, not just most influential, but just players that have inspired a whole other different generation.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Role players' impact on championship teams
quotes.excerpt: I don't think either of them would trade anything nor should they. They've both had outstanding careers.
quotes.quote: I don't think either of them would trade anything nor should they. They've both had outstanding careers. But championships are weighed. And now it's different when you are a role player like Channing and Perk, that's a very, very different position than if you're Dwyane Wade or James Harden as you're carrying a team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Role players' value in championship runs
quotes.excerpt: When Kevin Durant played, he played a certain way, but then if you think, they were sacking in the West before Kevin Durant got there.
quotes.quote: When Kevin Durant played, he played a certain way, but then if you think, they were sacking in the West before Kevin Durant got there and then they changed for him. Fred VanVleet gets hurt, so we there's a lot of talk about what if. Hey, Fred on that team, shout out, shout out to the Road Trippin' contributor.
